title: Anthropic lance Claude pour les conseillers financiers avec des connecteurs partenaires - Unite.AI
description: Anthropic lance Claude pour les conseillers financiers avec des connecteurs partenaires  Unite.AI
bottomLine: Anthropic embeds Claude AI into financial advisory platforms via partner connectors, extending AI reach into regulated professional services.
keyFindings: Anthropic has launched Claude integration capabilities specifically designed for financial advisors with built-in partner connectors.
The connectors enable seamless embedding of Claude into existing financial advisory workflows and systems.
This move targets professional services sector, traditionally underserved by general-purpose AI assistants.
Integration includes compliance-aware features suitable for regulated financial advisory environments.
whyItMatters: Belgian financial institutions and advisory firms may adopt Claude instead of building in-house AI research workflows; Elsevier should position LeapSpace's research-grade literature integration and compliance features as superior for evidence-based advisory decision-making.
actionItems: Map Belgian financial advisory firms to understand current research tool adoption and AI readiness.
Develop LeapSpace use case for financial research and due diligence workflows versus general Claude.
Identify whether Anthropic connectors include scientific literature or only market/financial data sources.

title: OpenAI Foundation lance le programme Public Data for Health - Unite.AI
description: OpenAI Foundation lance le programme Public Data for Health  Unite.AI
bottomLine: OpenAI Foundation launches public health data program, positioning OpenAI as infrastructure layer for healthcare and research institutions.
keyFindings: OpenAI Foundation introduced a Public Data for Health program to make health data more accessible and usable.
Program aims to support researchers and healthcare institutions in leveraging public datasets for research.
Represents OpenAI's strategic move into healthcare and life sciences research infrastructure.
Offers potential free or subsidized data access to align with public health goals and build institutional adoption.
whyItMatters: Belgian medical centres and research institutes may view OpenAI's health data program as a one-stop infrastructure solution; Elsevier must emphasize that Scopus/ScienceDirect provide curated, peer-reviewed evidence and Scopus indexing of health studies—critical for research validation that raw data programs cannot guarantee.
actionItems: Clarify scope of OpenAI's health data program: does it index or link to peer-reviewed literature?
Develop messaging around Scopus + ScienceDirect as the gold standard for evidence synthesis in health research.
Conduct outreach to Belgian university medical centres to discuss competitive positioning versus OpenAI's offering.

title: Google lance les modèles vocaux Gemini 3.8 Live et Extended Thinking - Unite.AI
description: Google lance les modèles vocaux Gemini 3.8 Live et Extended Thinking  Unite.AI
bottomLine: Google advances Gemini voice models with real-time interaction and extended reasoning, raising bar for AI-driven research assistants.
keyFindings: Google launched Gemini 3.8 Live with native voice capabilities for real-time conversational AI interactions.
Extended Thinking feature enhances Gemini's reasoning depth, enabling more complex problem-solving tasks.
Real-time voice interface lowers friction for researchers to query and synthesize information verbally.
These capabilities directly compete with conversational research assistants and literature discovery interfaces.
whyItMatters: Belgian academic institutions may prefer Google's integrated voice + reasoning model for research workflows; Elsevier must position LeapSpace's domain-specific literature grounding, peer-review validation, and ScienceDirect indexing as advantages over generic AI reasoning without research-grade source control.
actionItems: Test Gemini 3.8 Live with sample research queries to benchmark against LeapSpace capabilities and user experience.
Develop messaging emphasizing LeapSpace's literature-grounded, peer-review-validated approach versus generic reasoning models.
Plan pilot with Belgian universities to demonstrate LeapSpace as a research-specific alternative to consumer AI assistants.
